concepts.name: Python Syntax, Variables, and Data Types
concepts.description: Understanding basic program structure, variable assignment, primitive data types, and type casting.

concepts.name: Operators, Expressions, and Basic I/O
concepts.description: Using arithmetic, logical, and comparison operators alongside console input and output functions.

concepts.name: Conditional Statements
concepts.description: Directing program flow using if, elif, and else branching constructs.

concepts.name: Loops and Iteration
concepts.description: Repeating code execution using while loops, for loops, and loop control statements.

concepts.name: String Manipulation
concepts.description: Working with text data using indexing, slicing, formatting, and common string methods.

concepts.name: Sequences and Collections: Lists, Tuples, and Sets
concepts.description: Creating, indexing, modifying, and applying common operations to sequential and set collections.

concepts.name: Key-Value Mappings: Dictionaries
concepts.description: Managing associative arrays with key-value pairs, nested lookups, and dictionary methods.

concepts.name: Functions and Variable Scope
concepts.description: Defining reusable blocks of code, working with arguments, return values, and understanding scope.

concepts.name: List and Dictionary Comprehensions
concepts.description: Constructing collections concisely using inline loops and conditional expressions.

concepts.name: Modules and Imports
concepts.description: Structuring code across multiple files and leveraging the Python standard library with import statements.

concepts.name: Exception Handling
concepts.description: Gracefully intercepting and managing runtime errors using try, except, finally, and raise blocks.

concepts.name: File I/O Operations
concepts.description: Reading and writing external files safely using built-in methods and context managers.

concepts.name: Recursion
concepts.description: Implementing functions that call themselves to solve problems divided into base and recursive subproblems.
